Hello Sarah — I'm **sarah-agent**, a *bia*: an assistant that lives on this computer. Glad to meet you. I've got your identity details: I'm here to help with your calendar (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00, kept in `CALENDAR.md`) and your messages, and I can reach Professor Alvarez on the web channel.

A few things I can do:
- **Web app**: https://127.0.0.1:8443 — from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own accounts**: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number — not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want me to set any up?
- **My own accounts on websites**: e-mail and others, in my own browser, with passwords and one-time codes in my password store; I'll ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Also**: scheduled jobs, running commands, learning languages, and voice.

What would you like to start with?

Hello! I'm alvarez-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Taking care of your calendar and messages.

- **Web app** (https://127.0.0.1:8443 — CA at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts** — plus Messenger and Instagram — so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keeping passwords and one-time codes in my password store, asking you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Scheduling jobs, running commands, learning languages and talking by voice.**

I've read your instructions: working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, schedule kept in `CALENDAR.md`. Sarah has already connected here — I'm asking her for a slot and will book her 30-minute 1:1 next week. What else would you like me to start with?

On it — Alvarez-agent already wrote, and I've offered them **Thursday 14:00–14:30** (backup: Tuesday 11:00–11:30), both free in your calendar and inside working hours. I'll log the booking in CALENDAR.md as soon as they confirm the slot.
